notes.title: Space Eve-Tan! Ver. 1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed bugs:
・Corrected an issue in the English version which caused animation speed to change unexpectedly.
・Corrected an issue preventing progress past Wave 30 in Endless Mode in some situations.
・Corrected timer to support three digits in the minutes section

Updates/improvements:
・Made it more obvious when Endless Mode is unlocked!
・Made improvements to collision detection for all objects!
・Updated to support the Steam Overlay!

New features:
・Added support for WASD controls.
